title: 专利化学实体识别与结构归一化评测数据集 / Patent Chemical NER and Structure Normalization Benchmark

record_id.description: 章节记录的唯一标识。 / Unique identifier for a section record.

publication_number.description: 本条章节所属专利的公开号。 / Publication number of the patent containing this section.

language.description: 章节语言代码：CN＝中文，CNT＝繁体中文，EN＝英文，JP＝日文，KR＝韩文。 / Section language code: CN = Chinese, CNT = Traditional Chinese, EN = English, JP = Japanese, KR = Korean.

section.description: 章节类型：claim＝完整权利要求章节；description＝完整说明书章节。 / Section type: claim = complete claims section; description = complete description section.

text.description: 完整权利要求章节或说明书章节的HTML文本。 / HTML text of a complete claims or description section.

ground_truth.description: 实体级评测参考答案列表，每个对象对应一处实体提及；无参考实体时为[]。 / Entity-level evaluation reference answers, with one object per entity mention; [] when there are no reference entities.

start.description: 实体在本条text中的起始位置，包含该位置；从0开始，按Unicode码点计数，HTML标签字符也计入。 / Inclusive, zero-based start offset of the entity in this record's text, measured in Unicode code points including HTML markup characters.

end.description: 实体在本条text中的结束位置，不包含该位置；与start构成左闭右开区间。 / Exclusive end offset of the entity in this record's text, forming a half-open interval with start.

text.description: 实体在章节中的名称文本。 / Entity name text in the section.

label.description: 化学实体类别编码。ChemicalCompound与compound均表示化学实体，不区分化学对象子类。 / Chemical entity class code. ChemicalCompound and compound both denote chemical entities and do not distinguish chemical object subtypes.

smiles.description: 实体结构的SMILES参考表示；空字符串表示无可用的SMILES参考。 / SMILES representation of the entity's reference structure; an empty string indicates no available SMILES reference.

inchikey.description: 实体结构的InChIKey参考标识；空字符串表示无可用的InChIKey参考。 / InChIKey identifier of the entity's reference structure; an empty string indicates no available InChIKey reference.

mention_form.description: 实体名称在文本中的表达类型 / How the entity name is expressed in the text. SYSTEMATIC_NAME（全称 / Full name）：全称或明确结构名称，包括IUPAC名称及能确定化学身份的短名称。 / Full or explicit structural name, including IUPAC names and short names with a definite chemical identity. TRIVIAL_COMMON_NAME（俗名 / Common name）：化合物惯用名、药物通用名或明确指向单一成分的商品名。 / Conventional chemical name, generic drug name, or trade name identifying a single ingredient. UNAMBIGUOUS_ABBREVIATION（缩写 / Abbreviation）：当前语境中化学身份明确的名称缩写，例如DMSO、DCM。研发代码、编号和氨基酸序列符号不属于此类。 / Name abbreviation with an unambiguous chemical identity in context, such as DMSO or DCM. Development codes, identifiers, and amino-acid sequence symbols are excluded. UNAMBIGUOUS_FORMULA（结构简式 / Condensed structural formula）：化学身份明确的结构简式或元素符号，例如CH3COOH、Cu；不能确定具体结构的分子式不属于此类。 / Unambiguous condensed structural formula or chemical element symbol, such as CH3COOH or Cu. Molecular formulas that do not identify a definite structure are excluded. null（无类型信息 / No category information）：无名称表达类型信息。 / No name-form category information.

description: 面向专利化学实体识别与结构归一化的多语言评测数据集，覆盖中文、英文、日文和韩文。公开版包含11篇专利的11份完整权利要求章节与11份完整说明书章节，共22条独立输入，配有6,334处实体提及的名称、位置、类别、名称表达类型及可用的SMILES、InChIKey结构参考。 / A multilingual benchmark for chemical entity recognition and structure normalization in Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean patent text. The public edition contains 22 independent complete section inputs from 11 patents (11 claims sections and 11 description sections), with 6,334 entity mentions, reference names, offsets, class codes and name forms, plus available SMILES and InChIKey structure references.
